name: Re-pin MCP tools
summary: Review an observed MCP tool inventory and update source pins only after exact human confirmation.
description: A maintainer slash command that compares a bounded tools/list observation with the generated registry, produces a content digest, pauses for exact human confirmation, then updates source pins and records review evidence.
risk_reason: It changes source MCP pins after an exact human digest confirmation, altering future tool trust decisions.
refuses: It does not accept a pin change without an exact human repetition of the deterministic proposal digest.
It does not widen egress, secret access, transport, runtime launch, or tool mutation authority.
It does not treat MCP annotations or descriptions as enforcement and does not skip the full repository checks.

entrypoints.purpose: Require a clean toolkit source worktree and the MCP verification inputs before review begins.
Compare a bounded observed tool inventory with pins and produce a deterministic confirmation digest.

produces: an explicitly confirmed MCP pin change with a deterministic proposal digest, durable review evidence, and a hash-chained ledger citation
requires: a clean Youdede toolkit source worktree and a bounded JSON tools/list observation

flags.name: server
flags.description: Restrict review to one exact curated Youdede MCP server name.

flags.name: observed
flags.description: Use one bounded JSON file containing the observed tools/list result.

flags.name: evidence
flags.description: Write the accepted proposal receipt to one explicit repository-relative JSON path.

operational.latency_reason: The command follows a precondition check and multiple workflow steps while it reviews an observed MCP tool inventory and updates source pins only after exact human confirmation.
